[SWS_CanNm_00333]
Upstream requirements: RS_Nm_02527, SRS_BSW_00483
⌈If CanNmComUserDataSupport is enabled and if CanNm is in RepeatMessage state
or NormalOperation state and if CanNm_Transmit() is called CanNm shall request
an additional transmission of the NM PDU with the current data.⌋
Note: The call of CanNm_Transmit request to transmit a NM PDU between the pe-
riodic transmissions with the current data (e.g., system bytes, user data and PNC bit
vector).
